main_text.p: ܣܝܡܐ S.Christianus.Foem. ܐܢܢܐ Annus Christianus. In Clausulis librorum.
מִשְׁחָא, מִשְׁחָה Ch. & Syr.Oleum, unguetum, pinguedo.Plur. מִשְׁחִין.
מִשְׁחָן Ch. Idem. Plur. מִשְׁחָנִין טָבִין Olea pretiosa,Esth.6. 11.& cap.1.1.in Targ.sec.
מִשְׁחָתָא, מִשְׁחָתָא, מִשְׁחָא Chal. Mensura,dimensio: Item Statera, Bilanx, Jobi 31. 6. & Proverb. 20. 23. & sic convenit cum מסחתא, מ & ש permutatis.Plur. מִשְׁחָן מִשְׁחָתָא.
ܠܐܢܐ Syr. Idem. ܐܢܢ ܣܠܐ Plus quàm est mensura nostra,Supra modum,2.ad Cor. 10.12. vide & v.14.
מֶשֶׁךְ Hebr. Traxit, extraxit, protraxit, protendit: Hinc Chal. דמושכיה נהרא Quam trahebat fluvius,Gen.9.20.in Jon.

מוֹשְׁכָא, מַשְׁכָא, מֶשֶׁךְ Ch. ܣܡܐ Syr.Pellis, Cutis, sic dicta,quòd super corpus tracta est,Corium. Affine est Grecum μέσχος, aut σκύτος.Pl.מַשְׁכִין, const.מַשְׁכֵי Syr. ܠܒܫܐ Induti pellibus ovillis & caprinis,ad Hebr.11.37,
מַשְׁלִיא מֶשֶׁל, Ch. Fuscina, fuscinula,tridens. Plur. מַשְׁלִיתָא & מַשְׁלִיתָא מַשְׁלִין, Exo.38.3.& 27.3.in Jon.ubi in Targ. Hier. punctatum est מַשְׁלִיתָא.
מִמְשַׁלָּה Heb. Dominiu,dominatus, a מָשַׁל Dominari, Hinc in T. בְּכָל מִמְשַׁלְתִּי In toto dominio meo,Est.1.22.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are printed in their scripts; the transliterated Hebrew/Syriac forms above are approximate and several vowel points are uncertain. Lines marked with pointed Hebrew are given as close as the scan allows. Some letters at the right margin are show-through from the reverse page and omitted.
